label: DIVINE_PERSON_2: A Trinitarian person is not an additional divine being in this model
term: divine person (outside the Q11 divine-being domain)
definition: A Trinitarian person is not an additional divine being in this model. No Person type or person-individuation map is introduced. The Q11 result quantifies over the original IsGod predicate on Being and addresses numerical plurality of Gods, not the personal distinctions of Trinitarian theology.
note: Domain exclusion for this bounded philosophical reading, not a formalization or proof of Trinitarian doctrine. The q.11 discussion of many Gods and q.3 suppositum/nature terminology are not applied to divine persons. A formal person ontology and its source readings would require separate work.
